title: Picard bundles and Twisted Picard bundles on the Jacobian of a curve
summary: Let $Y$ denote an irreducible projective curve with at most nodes as singularities and defined over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. We study the restriction of the twisted Picard bundles on the compactified Jacobian $\overline{J}(Y)$ of $Y$ to the embedded curve in $\overline{J}(Y)$. As an application, we show that for $g =2$ and each integer $r \ge 3$, there is a two-dimensional family of stable ACM bundles on the compactified Jacobian which has the Picard bundle in its limit.
